part1.text: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What do you usually do in the evenings?
Do you like cooking? Why or why not?
Do you prefer to study in the morning or at night?
How do you usually travel to work or school?
What kind of weather do you enjoy most, and why?
Tell me about a hobby you have had for a long time.
How has the area where you live changed in recent years?
Do you prefer spending time with friends or alone? Why?
What kinds of music do you listen to?
How important is it for you to keep up with the news?
Would you like to live in a different country in the future? Why?
What do you think are the best ways to learn a new skill?
How do you usually manage your time when you are busy?
Do you think technology has made your daily life easier or more complicated?

cue_cards.text: Describe a meal you enjoyed with your family.
points: where and when you ate it

followups.text: Why do people enjoy eating together?
How have family meals changed over the years?

cue_cards.text: Describe a place you would like to visit in the future.

followups.text: Why do some people prefer to travel abroad rather than stay in their own country?
What are the benefits and problems of tourism for local people?

cue_cards.text: Describe a person who helped you learn something important.
points: how you feel about it now

followups.text: What qualities make a good teacher?
Should schools or families be more responsible for teaching children good values?

cue_cards.text: Describe a time when you had to learn to use a new piece of technology.
points: why you needed to use it
how easy or difficult it was

followups.text: Do older people find it harder to adopt new technology? Why?
How might technology change education over the next twenty years?
